bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.reason: 9kg front loading with automatic liquid-detergent dosing; the washer to assess for the Bosch stack below.
bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.fit: 598mm wide; 636mm deep with the door closed.
bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,073mm with the door open plus usable loading space. Dosing needs the right settings and cleaning; a stacked dryer and kit cost extra.

lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.reason: 8kg loads where front-to-back space is limited and the dryer can go elsewhere.
lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.fit: 600mm wide; 535mm deep with the door closed.
lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 20mm each side and 100mm behind. It cannot support a stacking kit; owner reports on noise vary.

lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.reason: 9kg loads and top access, with no benchtop or dryer above the washer.
lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.fit: 590mm wide; fully open lid reaches 1,339mm high.
lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 20mm each side and 100mm behind. Check drum reach and gentle-cycle controls in person.

bosch-wqg24201au-laundry-fit-good-guys.reason: A separate 9kg heat pump dryer for floor-standing use or the documented Bosch stack.
bosch-wqg24201au-laundry-fit-good-guys.fit: 598mm wide; 648mm deep with the door closed.
bosch-wqg24201au-laundry-fit-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,096mm door-open depth and maintenance access. Expect long cycles; budget for the approved kit and fitting if stacking.

bosch-sms6hci02a-good-guys.reason: A full-width freestanding replacement when the cabinet and loading space suit a 60cm machine.
bosch-sms6hci02a-good-guys.tradeoff: Door-open depth is 1,155mm before standing room. Confirm cavity dimensions and worktop arrangements; this is not an integrated cabinet-door model.

bosch-sps6iki01a-good-guys.reason: A 45cm freestanding option where a full-width dishwasher cannot fit; 10 place settings.
bosch-sps6iki01a-good-guys.tradeoff: The narrower racks sacrifice room for bulky cookware. Check your largest pans, the required cavity and hose route; body width alone does not prove fit.

westinghouse-wtm4302wd-r-good-guys.reason: A top freezer with 329L fridge space and 102L freezer space; useful if fresh-food capacity takes priority.
westinghouse-wtm4302wd-r-good-guys.fit: 699mm body width; 759mm including the two 30mm side gaps.
westinghouse-wtm4302wd-r-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 90mm above and 50mm behind in the documented arrangement. This white right-hinge model needs extra hinge-side room for shelf removal near a wall.

lg-gb-b400ps-fridge-fit-good-guys.reason: A bottom freezer with 308L fridge space and 128L freezer space; compare when side clearance is tight.
lg-gb-b400ps-fridge-fit-good-guys.fit: 697mm body width; 705mm including two 4mm side gaps.
lg-gb-b400ps-fridge-fit-good-guys.tradeoff: Still needs more than 50mm behind, overhead clearance and door access. The small side gap is not permission to push it against the back wall.

bosch-wqg24201au-good-guys.reason: 9kg heat pump for regular, larger loads where energy use matters more than quick cycles.
bosch-wqg24201au-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,096mm door-open depth and maintenance access. Higher upfront cost, long cycles and filter/heat-exchanger care; not wall mountable.

electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.reason: 6kg vented for smaller, occasional loads when a suitable exhaust arrangement is available.
electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.fit: 600mm wide × 795mm high × 560mm deep body; installation needs more space.
electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.tradeoff: Smaller capacity, two-star energy rating and moist exhaust. Confirm installed depth, ventilation, fitting and any optional vent kit before comparing total cost.

tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.reason: A matching furniture door and hidden controls, with 14 place settings.
tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.fit: 598mm body width; planning niche 600W × 815–875H × at least 550D mm.
tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.tradeoff: Cabinet panel is extra. Check panel weight, plinth movement, fixing and services; allow 1155mm door-open depth plus loading room.

tgg-gap-haier-hrf510fhs.reason: 372L fresh-food space and a 137L freezer, with refillable chilled water instead of plumbing.
tgg-gap-haier-hrf510fhs.tradeoff: Both doors and the drawer need operating space. Smaller freezer, manual ice and regular tank refilling; check large-container and ice-tray access.
